fullText.simplified:
三、修炼千年

    青蛇想知道她和白衣姑娘谁的法力更强。她动了动身体，变成一道青色的闪电。白衣姑娘笑了笑，变成一道白色的闪电。两道闪电在空中相遇，发出亮眼的火光。火光中，一青一白两条蛇影跳出树林，飞向天空。
    原来白衣姑娘也不是人，她的原形也是蛇——一条白蛇。
    两条蛇在天上地下打来打去，云里、山头、林中、河边都有它们的身影。黑色的天空被闪电照亮，大地也跟着动了起来。天亮时，青蛇的力气用完了，白蛇的闪电劈在身上，她疼得大叫。
    “不打了！不打了！”人头蛇身的青蛇掉在了地上。
    白蛇变成白衣姑娘，从天上轻轻落下。“现在你相信我比你强了吗？”她问。
    “相信！相信！”青蛇连连点头。
    白蛇对青蛇用了一个法术，青蛇马上就不疼了，蛇身也变成了人身。青蛇满意地看着自己的身体，高兴地笑了。
    “我修炼了一千年，已经修得人身。你只修炼了七百年，法力还不强，所以有时候会是人头蛇身。”白蛇说。
    “一千年？你真的比我大！”青蛇羡慕地说，“姐姐，你的脸这么漂亮，也是因为修炼了一千年吗？”
    白蛇说：“只要你以后好好修炼，会比我更好看的。”
    “虽然我不信，但听姐姐这么说，我还是很高兴。”青蛇笑着说，“以后我会好好修炼的。”
    “那就好。我走了。”
    “姐姐，你去哪儿？”
    “人间。”
    “去人间做什么？”
    “找一个人，他救过我。”
    “一个人？救过你？我的意思是，我们是妖，有人愿意救一只妖？”
    “我想并不是每个人都害怕妖。”
    青蛇很吃惊。她想了想，问：“我能和你一起去吗？我也想去人间看看。”
    白蛇没有说话，不知道该不该答应她。
    “姐姐放心，以后我都听你的话！不吃人，也不害人！”
    白蛇还是不说话。
    “姐姐，我一个人在山里修炼了七百年，没有亲人，也没有朋友，一直都是一个人。今天遇到姐姐，你不但长得漂亮，法力还高强，我真的太喜欢了！我想以后都跟着你，你去哪儿，我就去哪儿！”
    白蛇想了想，说：“在人间没有在山里舒服，你真的愿意和我一起去？”
    “愿意愿意！”
    “你一直叫我姐姐，你有名字吗？”
    “没有。”
    “你是青色的，我叫你小青，好吗？”
    “我喜欢这个名字，谢谢姐姐！”
    “那好吧，小青，以后你就跟着我吧。”
    “太好了！”小青高兴极了，“姐姐，那你叫什么名字？”
    “我叫白素贞。”
    “这个名字好！一听就是个漂亮姑娘的名字！”

三、修煉千年

    青蛇想知道她和白衣姑娘誰的法力更強。她動了動身體，變成一道青色的閃電。白衣姑娘笑了笑，變成一道白色的閃電。兩道閃電在空中相遇，發出亮眼的火光。火光中，一青一白兩條蛇影跳出樹林，飛向天空。
    原來白衣姑娘也不是人，她的原形也是蛇——一條白蛇。
    兩條蛇在天上地下打來打去，雲裡、山頭、林中、河邊都有牠們的身影。黑色的天空被閃電照亮，大地也跟著動了起來。天亮時，青蛇的力氣用完了，白蛇的閃電劈在身上，她疼得大叫。
    “不打了！不打了！”人頭蛇身的青蛇掉在了地上。
    白蛇變成白衣姑娘，從天上輕輕落下。“現在你相信我比你強了嗎？”她問。
    “相信！相信！”青蛇連連點頭。
    白蛇對青蛇用了一個法術，青蛇馬上就不疼了，蛇身也變成了人身。青蛇滿意地看著自己的身體，高興地笑了。
    “我修煉了一千年，已經修得人身。你只修煉了七百年，法力還不強，所以有時候會是人頭蛇身。”白蛇說。
    “一千年？你真的比我大！”青蛇羨慕地說，“姐姐，你的臉這麼漂亮，也是因為修煉了一千年嗎？”
    白蛇說：“只要你以後好好修煉，會比我更好看的。”
    “雖然我不信，但聽姐姐這麼說，我還是很高興。”青蛇笑著說，“以後我會好好修煉的。”
    “那就好。我走了。”
    “姐姐，你去哪兒？”
    “人間。”
    “去人間做什麼？”
    “找一個人，他救過我。”
    “一個人？救過你？我的意思是，我們是妖，有人願意救一隻妖？”
    “我想並不是每個人都害怕妖。”
    青蛇很吃驚。她想了想，問：“我能和你一起去嗎？我也想去人間看看。”
    白蛇沒有說話，不知道該不該答應她。
    “姐姐放心，以後我都聽你的話！不吃人，也不害人！”
    白蛇還是不說話。
    “姐姐，我一個人在山裡修煉了七百年，沒有親人，也沒有朋友，一直都是一個人。今天遇到姐姐，你不但長得漂亮，法力還高強，我真的太喜歡了！我想以後都跟著你，你去哪兒，我就去哪兒！”
    白蛇想了想，說：“在人間沒有在山裡舒服，你真的願意和我一起去？”
    “願意願意！”
    “你一直叫我姐姐，你有名字嗎？”
    “沒有。”
    “你是青色的，我叫你小青，好嗎？”
    “我喜歡這個名字，謝謝姐姐！”
    “那好吧，小青，以後你就跟著我吧。”
    “太好了！”小青高興極了，“姐姐，那你叫什麼名字？”
    “我叫白素貞。”
    “這個名字好！一聽就是個漂亮姑娘的名字！”

sentences.english: The white snake thought for a moment and said, “It’s not as comfortable in the human world as it is in the mountains.

sentences.simplified: 你真的愿意和我一起去？”
sentences.traditional: 你真的願意和我一起去？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhēn de yuàn yì hé wǒ yì qǐ qù
sentences.english: Are you really willing to go with me?”

sentences.pinyin: yuàn yì yuàn yì
sentences.english: “Yes, yes!”

sentences.simplified: “你一直叫我姐姐，你有名字吗？”
sentences.traditional: “你一直叫我姐姐，你有名字嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ yì zhí jiào wǒ jiě jie nǐ yǒu míng zi ma
sentences.english: “You keep calling me Older Sister, do you have a name?”

sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu
sentences.english: “No.”

sentences.simplified: “你是青色的，我叫你小青，好吗？”
sentences.traditional: “你是青色的，我叫你小青，好嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì qīng sè de wǒ jiào nǐ xiǎo qīng hǎo ma
sentences.english: “You are green-colored, can I call you Xiaoqing?”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge míng zi xiè xie jiě jie
sentences.english: “I like this name. Thank you, Older Sister!”

sentences.simplified: “那好吧，小青，以后你就跟着我吧。”
sentences.traditional: “那好吧，小青，以後你就跟著我吧。”
sentences.pinyin: nà hǎo ba xiǎo qīng yǐ hòu nǐ jiù gēn zhe wǒ ba
sentences.english: “Alright then, Xiaoqing. From now on, you can come with me.”

sentences.simplified: “太好了！”小青高兴极了，“姐姐，那你叫什么名字？”
sentences.traditional: “太好了！”小青高興極了，“姐姐，那你叫什麼名字？”
sentences.pinyin: tài hǎo le xiǎo qīng gāo xìng jí le jiě jie nà nǐ jiào shén me míng zi
sentences.english: “Amazing!” Xiaoqing was extremely happy, “Older Sister, then what is your name?”

sentences.pinyin: wǒ jiào bái sù zhēn
sentences.english: “My name is Bai Suzhen.”

sentences.simplified: “这个名字好！一听就是个漂亮姑娘的名字！”
sentences.traditional: “這個名字好！一聽就是個漂亮姑娘的名字！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge míng zi hǎo yì tīng jiù shì ge piào liang gū niang de míng zi
sentences.english: “That’s a good name! It sounds like the name of a beautiful girl!”

sentence_translations: 3. Cultivating for a Thousand Years
The green snake wanted to know who had stronger magical powers, she or the girl in white.
She moved her body a bit, and turned into a bolt of green lightning.
The girl in white smiled and turned into a bolt of white lightning.
The two bolts of lightning met in the sky, emitting an eye-catching flare.
In the flare, two snake shadows, one green and one white, leaped out of the forest and soared into the sky.
It turned out that the girl in white was not a human either. Her true form was also a snake—a white snake.
The two snakes fought back and forth in the sky and on the ground.
Their silhouettes appeared in the clouds, on the mountain top, in the forest, and by the river.
The black sky was illuminated by lightning, and the earth began to stir as well.
At dawn, the green snake’s strength was exhausted.  The white snake’s lightning struck her body, and she cried out in pain.
“No more fighting! No more fighting!” The green snake, with a human head and a snake body, fell to the ground.
The white snake transformed into a girl in white, and gently descended from the sky.
“Now, do you believe that I’m stronger than you?” she asked.
“Yes! Yes!” the green snake nodded repeatedly.
The white snake cast a spell on the green snake, and the green snake immediately stopped feeling pain.
Her snake body also transformed into human form. The green snake looked at her body with satisfaction and smiled happily.
“I have cultivated for a thousand years, and have already attained human form.
You have only cultivated for seven hundred years, so your magical powers are not strong yet.
That is why you sometimes have a human head and a snake body,” the white snake said.
“A thousand years? You really are older than me!” the green snake said with admiration, ..
.. “Older Sister, your face is so beautiful. Is that also because you have cultivated for a thousand years?”
The white snake said, “As long as you cultivate diligently in the future, you will look even better than me.”
“Although I don’t believe it, hearing Older Sister say that still makes me very happy.”
The green snake smiled and said, “I will cultivate diligently in the future.”
“Good! I’m leaving.”
“Older Sister, where are you going?”
“The human world.”
“What are you going to the human world for?”
“To find someone. He saved me in the past.”
“Someone? Who saved you? What I mean is, we are demons. There are people willing to save a demon?”
“I think not everyone is afraid of demons.”
The green snake was very surprised.
She thought for a moment and asked, “Can I go with you? I also want to go and see the human world.”
The white snake did not speak, unsure whether to agree.
“Older Sister, don’t worry, I’ll listen to you whatever you say from now on! I won’t eat people, nor harm them!”
The white snake still didn’t speak.
“Older Sister, I have been cultivating alone in the mountains for seven hundred years.
I have no family and no friends. I’ve always been alone.
Today I met Older Sister. Not only are you beautiful, but your magical powers are also excellent. I really like you a lot!
I want to follow you from now on. Wherever you go, I will go!”
The white snake thought for a moment and said, “It’s not as comfortable in the human world as it is in the mountains.
Are you really willing to go with me?”
“Yes, yes!”
“You keep calling me Older Sister, do you have a name?”
“No.”
“You are green-colored, can I call you Xiaoqing?”
“I like this name. Thank you, Older Sister!”
“Alright then, Xiaoqing. From now on, you can come with me.”
“Amazing!” Xiaoqing was extremely happy, “Older Sister, then what is your name?”
“My name is Bai Suzhen.”
“That’s a good name! It sounds like the name of a beautiful girl!”
